name: Dramatic Deep Dive
description: Full-Kanto Deep Dive 0.6 preview with modern Battle Art/Dramaless support plus an official legacy Dramatic Shape path. Legacy Dramatic Shape + Pokemon Stadium Overworld Models delegates underwater Pokemon rendering to the existing Stadium renderer to avoid double VoxelScene ownership; legacy Dramatic Shape without that add-on can use Deep Dive's native Stadium 2 path when the required StadiumRig/cache stack exists. HM08 progression now survives renderer discovery failure. Includes animated nearby Stadium 2 wildlife on modern providers, free-depth swimming, expanded Kanto seabeds, visible-only Wilds encounters, salvage and HM08 DIVE.
